skill.name: baoyu-infographic
skill.description: Generates professional infographics from source content using curated layout and visual style references.
skill.summary: Turns source content into structured infographic plans, prompts, and image-generation guidance.
skill.author: jimliu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, fenced examples, and visual design terms. The only confirmed issue is hidden user-home configuration access in SKILL.md, which is scoped but should be consent-gated. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious workflow was found.

remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit consent before reading $HOME/.baoyu-skills/baoyu-infographic/EXTEND.md, and show the exact path before access.
Document that EXTEND.md should contain only design preferences and no secrets, credentials, or private project data.

content.value_statement: Complex content is hard to turn into a clear visual story. This skill analyzes source material and builds infographic prompts with suitable layouts, styles, aspect ratios, and language choices.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes topic, data type, complexity, tone, and audience before visual planning.
Recommends 3 to 5 layout and style combinations from 20 layouts and 17 styles.
Preserves statistics, quotes, names, dates, and technical terms verbatim in structured content.
Builds image-generation prompts using selected layout, style, aspect ratio, and language.
Supports project or user preference files through EXTEND.md configuration.
Reports the chosen design options, language, output path, and generated assets.
limitations: It depends on an available image generation skill to create the final bitmap image.
It may need user confirmation before selecting layout, aspect ratio, or language.
Image accuracy depends on the image generator and the clarity of the source material.
It preserves source claims but does not independently verify their truth.

use_cases.title: Turn Lessons Into Study Visuals
use_cases.description: Create structured learning infographics from articles, notes, or curriculum material while preserving key facts exactly.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch and Strategy Graphics
use_cases.description: Convert product briefs, campaign plans, or positioning notes into polished visual summaries for presentations.

use_cases.title: Summarize Metrics Visually
use_cases.description: Transform KPI updates, status reports, and benchmark data into dashboard-style infographic prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Infographic
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an infographic from this content: [paste content]. Use the default layout and style unless another option fits better.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Specific Format
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a portrait infographic from [source]. Use a dashboard layout, corporate memphis style, and English labels.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Design Directions
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [source] and recommend four layout and style combinations. Explain the tradeoffs before generating the final prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Audience Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an infographic plan for [source] for executive readers. Preserve all numbers exactly, reduce text density, and prepare a square image prompt.

output_examples.input: A product launch memo with features, dates, target users, and launch goals.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a bento grid with a corporate memphis style, prepares structured sections, and creates an image prompt for launch messaging.

output_examples.input: A report with monthly revenue, conversion rate, churn, and support volume.
output_examples.output: The skill selects a dashboard layout, highlights key metrics, preserves numeric values, and prepares a prompt for a concise KPI graphic.

output_examples.input: A tutorial explaining a five-step onboarding process.
output_examples.output: The skill chooses a linear progression layout, creates step labels, and generates a clean prompt for a process infographic.

best_practices: Provide complete source content and state the intended audience before generation.
Confirm layout, style, aspect ratio, and language before creating the final image prompt.
Review extracted statistics and quotes before sending the prompt to an image generator.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent missing statistics or fill factual gaps without source material.
Do not skip design confirmation when the infographic is for publication or clients.
Do not store secrets, credentials, or private business data in EXTEND.md preference files.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates an infographic analysis, structured content, design recommendations, an image prompt, and a generated image when a generator is available.

faq.question: Can I choose the layout and style?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request a specific layout, style, aspect ratio, and language, or ask the skill to recommend options.

faq.question: How many layout and style choices are included?
faq.answer: The skill documents 20 layout types and 17 visual styles that can be combined for different content needs.

faq.question: Does it translate content?
faq.answer: It can prepare infographic text in a chosen language, but you should review translated wording before publication.

faq.question: Does it verify facts in my source?
faq.answer: No. It preserves source facts and wording, but it does not perform independent fact checking.

faq.question: Is a separate image generator required?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow expects an available image generation skill or tool to create the final bitmap image.
